# terminate gets no terminated event and disconnect no answer: the client
# moves on after each grace period and finally kills the adapter.
> initialize
< {"body": {"supportsConfigurationDoneRequest": true, "supportsTerminateRequest": true}}
> launch
< {}
< event initialized
> configurationDone
< {}
> terminate
< {}
> disconnect {"terminateDebuggee": true, "restart": false}
~ 20000ms
